description: This file defines a React component for the explore page of a career guidance application. It manages state, fetches filter options, handles user interactions for search and filters, and renders the main UI including search bar, filters, and results grid.

methods.name: ExploreClient
methods.description: Main React component managing the explore page UI, including fetching filter options, handling user search input, and rendering results.

methods.name: fetchOptions
methods.description: Fetches industry and skill options for filters from the API upon component mount.

methods.name: handleManualSearch
methods.description: Executes a search based on user input and filters, updating searchResults state.
